title: Orchard and Uniform
author: Noor Whitlock
blurb: Juniper Ashgrove, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
